title: 2025 AMC 12B Problem 4
statement: The value of the two-digit number \(\underline{a}\,\underline{b}\) in base seven equals the value of the two-digit number \(\underline{b}\,\underline{a}\) in base nine. What is \(a + b?\)

solutions.text:
Setting \(7a + b = 9b + a\) gives \(6a = 8b,\) so \(3a = 4b.\) Thus \(a=4t\) and \(b=3t.\) Because both are base-seven digits and \(a\ne0,\) only \(t=1\) works. Hence \(a=4, b=3,\) and indeed \(43_7 = 31 = 34_9.\) Therefore \(a+b=7.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Write each number in terms of its base: \(\underline{a}\,\underline{b}\) is \(7a + b\) and \(\underline{b}\,\underline{a}\) is \(9b + a\)
Set \(7a + b = 9b + a\) and simplify to a ratio between \(a\) and \(b\)
